falseSynonyms.zh: 管道裝配工不等於 plumber pipefitter 多處理大型、工業或高壓管道系統，工作範圍和 plumber 有重疊但不是同一職業。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A pipefitter usually works on industrial or large-scale piping systems.

falseSynonyms.zh: 燃氣工程技工不等於 plumber gas engineer 專處理燃氣設備／系統，通常需要不同資格。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Gas work is a separate regulated specialism in many places.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通渠工不等於 plumber drain cleaner 專門處理淤塞／排水問題，只是 plumbing 的一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Drain cleaning is a narrower service.

falseSynonyms.zh: 雜務維修員不等於 plumber handyman 可處理多種小型維修，但未必具水喉專業資格。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A handyman is a general repair worker.

falseSynonyms.zh: 工程師不等於 plumber engineer 是更廣且常有不同專業資格／職責的職稱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Engineer is not a direct synonym for plumber.

falseSynonyms.zh: 建築工／承建商不等於 plumber builder 負責建築工程整體或其他工種，不等於水喉專業。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Builder is construction-focused, not plumbing-specific.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在承辦工程 sense 接近 contractor 強調合約／商業責任，並非所有 plumber 都是 contractor。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Contractor is a business/contract role.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 plumber 是人；plumbing 是水喉工程／管道系統或相關工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Plumber names the worker; plumbing names the trade/work/system.
